EditTextPreference.app:title: Crew name
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: Shown large at the top of the main screen: the boat or the crew. Up to 24 characters; empty shows the app name.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Name shown to the crew
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: Leave empty to use the Android device name. Up to 32 bytes. Applies immediately.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Full duplex
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOn: The big button toggles the mic; everyone is heard at once. Best with a headset.
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOff: Hold the big button to talk; others are muted while you hold it.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Forward what this phone hears to its other links, so phones out of each other's range still connect through it. Leave on.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Opus compression
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: About a tenth of the bandwidth of raw audio. Falls back to raw by itself if this phone cannot encode Opus. Applies the next time the mic is keyed.

PreferenceCategory.app:title: WLAN — takes effect on the next Connect

EditTextPreference.app:title: Multicast group
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: An IPv4 multicast address, 224.0.0.0 to 239.255.255.255. Every phone on the crew must use the same one.

EditTextPreference.app:title: UDP port
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: 1024 to 65535, the same on every phone.

PreferenceCategory.app:title: Wi‑Fi Aware — takes effect on the next Connect

EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: 8 to 63 plain ASCII characters. Phones only link up when it matches, so it doubles as the crew name.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Hop limit
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: How many relays a packet may cross, 1 to 16. Also caps what this phone forwards for others. Applies immediately.
